c1000.description: Contours at multiples of 1000 m Limited to a 10 km buffer around the HOT flood-affected AOI (work/aoi_flood_10km.geojson) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m
fields.fade: always 0 for this class (uniform schema with c50/c10)

c500.description: Contours at multiples of 500 m, excluding those already in c1000 Limited to a 10 km buffer around the HOT flood-affected AOI (work/aoi_flood_10km.geojson) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m
fields.fade: always 0 for this class (uniform schema with c50/c10)

c100.description: Contours at multiples of 100 m, excluding those already in c500/c1000 Limited to a 2 km buffer around the HOT flood-affected AOI (work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m
fields.fade: always 0 for this class (uniform schema with c50/c10)

c50.description: Contours at multiples of 50 m, excluding those already in c100/c500/c1000. Clipped by height above river (HAND-style, owner direction 6 Sep 2026) instead of the flood AOI polygon, so lines fade out along the valley instead of stopping at a hard edge; see `fade`.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m
fields.fade: 0 = height above river < 80 m (full opacity), 1 = 80-100 m, 2 = 100-120 m (near-invisible); all bands hard-limited to work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson

c50.clip: Height-above-river bands (work/hab_band0.geojson, hab_band1.geojson, hab_band2.geojson; see tools/build_terrain.sh step 2b), each also limited to work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson

c10.description: All remaining 10 m contours, excluding those already in c50/c100/c500/c1000. Clipped by height above river (HAND-style, owner direction 6 Sep 2026) instead of the flood AOI polygon, so lines fade out along the valley instead of stopping at a hard edge; see `fade`.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m
fields.fade: 0 = height above river < 80 m (full opacity), 1 = 80-100 m, 2 = 100-120 m (near-invisible); all bands hard-limited to work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson

c10.clip: Height-above-river bands (work/hab_band0.geojson, hab_band1.geojson, hab_band2.geojson; see tools/build_terrain.sh step 2b), each also limited to work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson

contours.size_note: ~17 MB total (3315 .pbf files), under the ~120 MB target. c10/c50 are clipped by height above river (HAND-style) rather than the flood AOI polygon, split into three fade bands (see `fade` on c10/c50) and hard-limited to work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson; previous polygon-clipped tileset kept at work/contours_v10_aoi_polygon_clip (~16 MB) for comparison. c1000/c500/c100 remain full-extent within their own buffers since they are cheap.
